summary: HTTP transport now applies the resolved cookie/token credential to live requests (Cookie header for cookie strings, Authorization for bare tokens) instead of dropping it.
reason: Greptile PR #1528 P1: the generated live-request loop in client.go had an empty `if authHeader != ""` block that set no header, so IGNITION_TRANSPORT=http (and any non-GraphQL request) sent the X-CSRF-Token but no session credential and failed auth. No cookie jar is wired on this client, so the credential must be applied directly; Header.Set keeps it single-valued (no double-send WAF trip).
validated_outcome: New TestCookieCredentialRidesLiveRequest + TestBareTokenCredentialUsesAuthorization (httptest) assert the Cookie header carries the session string exactly once and bare tokens use Authorization; go test ./internal/client green.
